summary.scope: Seven source-qualified new works, same composer/performer. Local-key time scores, not global-home-key accuracy. Source variants are related revisions, not blind independent votes.

decision.reason: Predeclared analyst non-regression and boundary improvement conditions fail, although unanimous full-work macro rises slightly. Retain evaluation-only diagnostic; no rescue tuning.
decision.limits: One composer and known performer; local-key time agreement, not global-home-key accuracy or pop/artist generalization.

interpretation: One-second independent evidence loses accuracy relative to8-second independent evidence on these works. CT smoothing restores much of it but fails the boundary/non-regression conditions. This diagnostic suggests a context/resolution tradeoff; it does not validate any alternative method.
